Subject: SRV-512 staggered-invoice schedule & VAT paperwork request

Hi Marta / AP team,

Hope you had a good long weekend. Following up on invoice INV-2027-512 (attached) — we saw a partial ACH attempt come through last week but it looks like the bank rejected the full amount. To keep the project timeline intact, would you be open to a staggered payment approach? Proposed: 60% now (ACH) + 40% in 30 days (ACH or wire).

Action items I need from you:
- Confirm whether you can do 60% via ACH today and the remainder on 2027-07-01.
- If ACH is an issue, please confirm whether you prefer a single wire instead and we will provide wire details.
- Send the VAT invoice / tax documentation for our records so we can reconcile on our side (we need the VAT registration number and the invoice with VAT line item).
- If you can send remittance advice once payment is scheduled, that helps reconcile faster.

I’ve attached the invoice and a suggested staggered schedule for your AP team to review. If you prefer a call, happy to hop on one — I’m free today 11:00–12:00 PDT.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Stephanie — thanks for the note and for the clear options. Quick update: we attempted ACH for the full invoice on Monday but the payment bounced with a bank-level rejection flagged as "cross-border/tranx policy". Our bank recommended we either retry as two ACH movements within the same entity (which may still be blocked) or send an international wire.

We are inclined to do a wire to clear this quickly. Can you send wire instructions and confirm the exact amount you expect for the initial payment if we do a single wire versus staggering? Also — we need the VAT invoice (our AP can't post the payment without VAT documentation).

Cc'ing Carlos from AP to coordinate timing and fees — Carlos, can you advise on how quickly we can schedule a USD wire if Redwood confirms instructions? We typically need 24–48 hours for treasury approval.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Director, Finance Operations
Medisphere Health
marta.ruiz@medisphere.com
